title: 3DOF Angular Acceleration
text: Implement three-degrees-of-freedom equations of motion with respect to body axes, 4 inputs, 7 outputs, {Mass type} sets Mass type; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Axes} sets the body or wind, {Initial velocity}, {Initial body attitude} sets the initial pitch altitude, {Initial body rotation rate} sets the initial pitch rotation rate, {Initial incidence} sets the initial angle, {Initial position (x,z)} sets the initial location, {Initial mass}, {Inertia}, {Gravity Source}, {Acceleration due to gravity} sets the gravity source, {Include inertial acceleration}, {Velocity: e.g., ’u, ’w’} sets the velocity state name, {Position: e.g., ’Xe’, ’Ze’} sets the position state name, {Pitch angular rate e.g., ’q’} sets the pitch angular rate state name and {Pitch attitude: e.g., ’theta’} sets the pitch attitude state name. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Axes
params.values: Body or wind axes Body (default) | Wind

params.name: Mass type
params.values: Mass type Fixed (default) | Simple Variable | Custom Variable

params.name: Include inertial acceleration
params.values: Include inertial acceleration port off (default) | on

params.name: Velocity: e.g., {’u, ’w’}
params.values: Velocity state name ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Position: e.g., {’Xe’, ’Ze’}
params.values: Position state name ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces
